subject: general
question: Which river originates from Gaumukh Glacier, and flows for about 193 km before meeting Alaknanda to form the Ganga River at Devprayag?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhagirathi River**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bhagirathi River** originates from the **Gaumukh Glacier**, at an elevation of about 13,800 ft (4,200 meters), in the **Gangotri Group of glaciers** in the **Himalayas**.
 
• It then **flows **for approximately **193 km** before **meeting **the **Alaknanda **River **at Devprayag**, where they merge** to form the Ganga River**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kosi River originates **in **Nepal **and flows through Bihar before **joining the Ganges near Patna**.

 
 
• It is known as the "**Saptakoshi**" due to its seven major tributaries** in Nepal**.
 
• With a **length of 720 km (450 mi)**, the Kosi River drains 74,500 km³ (28,800 sq mi) in Tibet, Nepal, and Bihar.
 
 
 
• **Ghaghara River** **originates **in **Nepal **and flows through Uttar Pradesh before **joining the Ganges near Sonepur in Bihar**.
 
 
• It is called **Karnali River in Nepal**, **Mapcha Tsangpo in Tibet**, and the **lower Ghaghara in Awadh called Sarayu River**.
 
• The **total length** of the Ghaghara up to its confluence with the Ganges at Revelganj in Bihar** is 1,080 km (670 mi)**.
 
 
 
• **Gomati River** **originates **in **Uttar Pradesh** and flows through the state before **joining the Ganges near Varanasi**.
 
 
• It **course **through the **940-kilometre (580 mi)** stretch in northern plains.
